title: Developer-experience team config
description: Schema for developer-experience.yaml in a repository's convention home (default docs/conventions): the team layer of the developer-experience plugin's settings. Keys are read by /developer-experience:build-cli and listed in plugins/developer-experience/README.md, Configuration. Contract: docs/adr/0064-home-plugin-customization-in-docs-conventions-yaml.md.

verification.description: How much independent checking this plugin's skills run: off, light (the default: skip the verifier dispatch), standard (run it) or strict (also run the optional passes). Read from the default branch's committed copy only, so a branch cannot lower it. Levels: docs/contracts/verification-level/README.md.

verification_skills.description: Per-skill verification level, keyed by skill name (for example build-cli); an entry beats this file's verification value.
